collection.description: Two villagers hold a contest to see who can carry more coconuts: add one more, or call it a draw.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: It started as a joke. (subject) said (subject.he/she) could carry more coconuts than (friend). (friend) said (friend.he/she) could carry more coconuts than (subject). Now they are standing at the edge of the grove, each holding a teetering armful, while a small crowd of villagers counts. Neither of them can see over the top.

choices.label: Call It a Draw While You're Ahead

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "Draw," says (subject), through gritted teeth. "Draw," agrees (friend) instantly. They both put the coconuts down very, very carefully. The crowd is disappointed, having hoped for a disaster. (subject) and (friend) shake hands, then both go off separately to have a little lie down.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) reaches for one more coconut. The whole armful shifts, wobbles, and pours onto the ground, along with (subject). The crowd cheers. (friend), laughing, drops all of (friend.his/her) coconuts too. They declare it a draw, mostly because neither of them can stand up, and the villagers gather the coconuts for dinner.
